semiconductor_relevance: Medium — INNORES CO., LTD. provides critical sealing products used in semiconductor manufacturing and flat panel display industries.
summary: INNORES CO., LTD. specializes in sealing products such as FKM and FFKM o-rings, gate door valves, rubber pads, diaphragms, and bellows for the semiconductor and flat panel display industries. Their focus on innovative technology and high-quality products ensures reliable performance in critical applications, making them a valuable partner in the semiconductor value chain.
